cities.name: Seoul
cities.description: Explore royal palaces, the N Seoul Tower area and Hongdae's contemporary culture in South Korea's capital.

cities.name: Busan
cities.description: A coastal city with Haeundae, Gwangalli and the colourful hillside streets of Gamcheon Culture Village.

cities.name: Gyeongju
cities.description: Discover the former Silla capital through royal tombs, Bulguksa Temple and the city's historic landscape.

KR.note: Editorial city examples from official tourism sources; these are not statistical rankings of cities visited.

cities.name: Taipei
cities.description: Taiwan's capital brings together museums, temples, neighbourhood food and the Taipei 101 skyline.

cities.name: Tainan
cities.description: Visit Taiwan's former capital for Anping Old Fort, Confucius Temple and a distinctive local food tradition.

cities.name: Kaohsiung
cities.description: A southern harbour city with waterfront attractions, cultural spaces and access to the area's coastal scenery.

TW.note: Editorial city examples from Taiwan Tourism Administration; these are not statistical rankings of cities visited.

cities.name: Macao Peninsula
cities.description: Explore the historic centre around Senado Square and the Ruins of St Paul's, where Chinese and Portuguese heritage meet.

cities.name: Taipa Village
cities.description: Taipa's village streets and Taipa Houses combine local food, museums and Portuguese architectural influences.

cities.name: Coloane Village
cities.description: The old pier and village waterfront recall Coloane's fishing and ferry history and traditional dried-seafood trade.

MO.note: Macao is one city-region. These are districts and villages within it, not separate cities or visitor-volume rankings. Sources: Macao Government Tourism Office.

cities.name: Vientiane
cities.description: The Lao capital offers That Luang, Wat Sisaket, Patuxay and a Mekong promenade with markets and local food.

cities.name: Luang Prabang
cities.description: A heritage town where Buddhist temples and traditional architecture form the centre of a broader northern Laos visit.

cities.name: Pakse
cities.description: At the Mekong and Sedon confluence, Pakse is a gateway to Champasak, Vat Phou and the Bolaven Plateau.

LA.note: Editorial city examples from the official Tourism Laos portal; these are not statistical rankings of cities visited.

cities.name: Bandar Seri Begawan
cities.description: Brunei's capital combines landmark mosques, museums and Kampong Ayer's water-village heritage.

cities.name: Tutong
cities.description: Tutong town sits beside a river associated with mangroves, river cruises and traditional communities.

cities.name: Kuala Belait
cities.description: The Belait District Museum introduces the district's history and cultural diversity from its home in Kuala Belait.

BN.note: Editorial town and city examples from Brunei Tourism; these are not statistical rankings of cities visited.

cities.name: Manila
cities.description: Explore the historic Intramuros district, museums and contemporary arts alongside the capital's food and shopping.

cities.name: Cebu
cities.description: A major gateway combining urban heritage and local food with access to surrounding beaches and diving areas.

cities.name: Vigan
cities.description: Vigan's preserved historic streets and living traditions offer a distinctive heritage-city experience in northern Luzon.

PH.note: Editorial city examples from Philippine government tourism sources; these are not statistical rankings of cities visited.

cities.name: Yangon
cities.description: The former capital's tourism heritage includes Shwedagon Pagoda, the National Museum, Bogyoke Market and its historic centre.

cities.name: Mandalay
cities.description: Myanmar's last royal capital is associated with the palace, Shwenandaw Monastery and Kuthodaw Pagoda.

cities.name: Nay Pyi Taw
cities.description: Myanmar's administrative capital includes Uppatasanti Pagoda, museums and landscaped public spaces.

MM.note: Editorial place descriptions from Myanmar Ministry of Hotels and Tourism; these are not visitor rankings or claims about current opening or access.

cities.name: Phnom Penh
cities.description: Cambodia's capital is an international gateway and a centre of the country's political, cultural and urban life.

cities.name: Siem Reap
cities.description: The gateway to Angkor's Khmer archaeological landscape, including Angkor Wat and the Bayon temple at Angkor Thom.

cities.name: Battambang
cities.description: A UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy with rice-based culinary traditions, a riverside food street and local food initiatives.

KH.note: Editorial city examples from Cambodian state news and UNESCO heritage sources; these are not statistical rankings of cities visited.
